main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 5-bar return

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and Spearman > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Spearman correlation of forecast with 5-bar excess return

decided_by: t >= 2 but the Spearman correlation is at or below 0, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: A case is a holding-period bet of the forecast (a rise of at least 2 points from its lowest level on its side since the last bet), the first one in each 5-bar grid cell of a window; the t of the weighted mean sums the weighted deviations per day; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases/days' is reported as not observable.
